notes: v3 version string from PDF p.1: 'arXiv:2505.23824v3 [cs.CL] 1 Apr 2026' (NeurIPS 2025 Workshop: AI for Science). v1: arXiv:2505.23824v1 [cs.CL] 28 May 2025.

Main driver of the HR@5 drop across all checkers: v3 changed the Gemini 2.5 Pro judge from preview-05-06 to preview-06-05 (v3 p.4); v3 Table 3 shows the o3 judge is now much stricter (e.g., o3 checker PDF: o3-judge 50.2 in v3 vs 75.5 in v1). Dataset, prompts, problem counts and token usage are unchanged.
o3 cost changes ($0.321 -> $0.064 PDF; $0.383 -> $0.077 LaTeX) because v3 prices at standard June-2025 API rates (v1: early-May-2025). Other models' costs unchanged.

New in v3: AP@5 precision metric (PDF only) in Table 2 and per-judge AP in Table 3; total judge-confirmed true problems o3 350, Gemini 2.5 Pro 293, Claude 149 (v3 p.4). Recorded in notes, not added as table columns.

Removed in v3: the claim that o4-mini is the most cost-effective (abstract and Results); the v1 sentence on temperature 0 / fixed seed in Sec 2.4 (v3 keeps parameters only in Appendix B); 'specialized LaTeX training' wording; 'unqualified' judge wording (now 'might not qualify').

Not changed (out of editable scope): titles, aliases and filenames still carry v1 numbers (16.3%, 64.9%/71.0%, 59.6%, $0.321); the Description '> Table 2 shows ...' summary lines (blockquote paraphrase in the Description section) still carry v1 numbers and v1 page 4; verbatim quotes citing v1 pages (e.g., 'o4-mini seems to be the most cost-effective choice' which no longer appears in v3) are unchanged. Each page's Version update bullet flags this.
o3 page Methods Context quote (p.3) says 'We set model temperature to 0 and fixed the decoding seed' — that sentence is absent from v3 Sec 2.4; left unchanged as a verbatim quote.
Cost-per-hit figures on the o4-mini page ($0.10 vs $0.13) are my own arithmetic from v3 Table 2, labelled as such.
Page-number citations: v3 Results/Setup p.4, Table 2 p.5, Table 3 p.6, Appendix B p.11 (PDF page numbers equal printed page numbers).
